Use pressed to supply the current state and pressedChange to receive user toggles.

## Usage

```ts
import { toggle, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/toggle';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/toggle`. It [registers](../../registration/) 1 component for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

<a id="shadcn-toggle"></a>

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Root>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.

Namespace type exports `components.ToggleSize`, `components.ToggleVariant`, `components.ToggleVariants`.

- `components.toggleVariants` takes options `variant`, `size` and optional additional classes, and returns a CSS class string.
